OBJ exporter UV compatibility verification
========================================

Build:
- make: OK under -std=c89 -Wall -Wextra -pedantic -O2

Patched behavior:
- g3dtool skin /mnt/data/zombie(4).act 0.25 /mnt/data/zombie_patched_export.obj 0: OK
- first exported texture coordinate now uses negative V:
  vt 0.9901 -0.5045

Reason:
- External fragMOTION OBJ reference for the same zombie family uses negative V coordinates.
- Exporter now writes vt.v = -xskin.v to match that observed Genesis3D/fragMOTION OBJ convention.

Protocol audit:
- No malloc/realloc/free calls added.
- No heap allocator added.
- No float/double scalar fields added.
- Patch only changes OBJ text emission in g3d_tool.c.
